# Abraham Goes (Genesis 12:1)

## Emotional Focus
Trusting God when He says “go” to something new.

## Key KJV
“Get thee out of thy country… unto a land that I will shew thee.” (Genesis 12:1)

## Gentle Retelling
God told Abraham to leave his home and go to a new place. Abraham listened and obeyed. God took care of him every step of the way.

## Coloring Prompt
Abraham walking with his family and tents toward a new land under a bright sky.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“When God says go, He walks with you.”
